capabilities: Apply settings profiles written as notes
Draft profiles via a local-LLM chat
Show a diff before each write
Redact secrets from profiles and chat
extras: Version 1 does not cover appearance/CSS and will not write app.json, appearance.json, core-plugins.json, or community-plugins.json; the plugin never writes its own data.json. Chat was tested in Obsidian's mobile emulation, not on a physical device. Bilingual interface (English/German). Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+ because API keys use Obsidian's secret storage.
problem: Editing plugin and app settings JSON by hand is error-prone and hard to undo.

relations.evidence: Lessons learned from Config Sync (MIT, xooooooooox/obsidian-config-sync) informed several edge cases.
Endpoints come from the LLM Endpoint Manager if it is installed

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible local LLM server (LM Studio, Ollama, or MLX)

summary: Settings editor that applies reviewed profile notes or local-LLM chat drafts to plugin config files, with diffs, secret redaction, and rollback snapshots.
